title: Modern Art (Probably)
description: This mod replaces the in-game paintings with a collection of funny memes and nostalgic images.
body:
# 🖼️ Modern Art (Probably)

> **Replace Minecraft's vanilla paintings with hilarious memes, iconic internet moments, and nostalgic classics.**

![All of the paintings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cb95257d43871a7285aa147070209c5a5568d45_0.webp)

---

## ✨ Features

* Replaces **22 vanilla paintings**
* Filled with memes and funny references
* Includes nostalgic internet classics
* Lightweight resource pack with no gameplay changes
* Works in any world or server that supports resource packs

---

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Open **Options → Resource Packs**.
3. Enable **Meme Paintings**.
4. Move it **to the top** of your resource pack list.

If another resource pack changes paintings and is above this one, its paintings will take priority.

![Resource Packs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6468737fccda988db165ae833afb9ba750fcb39_0.webp)

---

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

### My paintings aren't changing

Make sure the pack is at the very top of your enabled resource packs. If another pack replaces paintings and has a higher priority, these textures won't appear.

### Does this work in multiplayer?

Yes! As long as **you** have the resource pack enabled, you'll see the custom paintings. Other players will need the pack as well if they want to see the same artwork.

### Does this affect gameplay?

No. This is a purely visual resource pack that only changes painting textures.

---

## 🚧 Beta

> This resource pack is currently in **beta**.

Some paintings may be updated, improved, or replaced in future releases based on community feedback.
